Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in

Class KfeReserveOverviewService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.KfeReserveOverviewService
@Service public class KfeReserveOverviewService extends Object
KFE reserve overview (ITEM 9 — vault mesh boundary audit).

Reports assets and liabilities separately. Never sums them into a single "total."

Liabilities:
Customer liabilities = available + pending + locked + auto_hold for CUSTODIAL_ONCHAIN and INTERNAL wallets only. Excludes:

  • WATCH_ONLY — user controls keys, no platform obligation
  • SYSTEM_FUNDS — platform equity, not customer debt
  • SYSTEM_PROFIT — undistributed profit tracked as subledger entry; included separately as systemProfitSats

Assets:
Assets are queried from external probes when available:

  • On-chain: confirmed UTXOs via BlockchainClient (scantxoutset/listunspent). Falls back to ledger observedSats when the client is unavailable.
  • Lightning: channel local balance + LND on-chain wallet via LightningChannelGateway. Falls back to 0 when unavailable.

WATCH_ONLY observed balances are reported as coldCustodyAssetsSats — visible on-chain but NOT controlled by the platform.

  • Method Details

    • overview

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public KfeReserveOverviewResponse overview()
      Returns the reserve overview with separate asset and liability sections.

      Liabilities = sum of user-facing balance buckets (available + pending + locked + hold) for CUSTODIAL_ONCHAIN and INTERNAL wallets only.

      On-chain customer assets start from cached ledger observedSats; an available Core client contributes a tip marker only. A live Lightning gateway contributes active channel local balances and its confirmed on-chain balance. Missing probes leave those additional buckets at zero; they are not replaced with unverified estimates. Exact arithmetic fails on overflow.

      Returns:
      DTO containing liability, asset, equity, coverage, chain marker, timestamp, and status
      Throws:
      ArithmeticException - if an accumulated bucket or derived total overflows
